newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico jobless rate 5.2 pct in Oct - Zedillo.
newsitem.headline: Mexico jobless rate 5.2 pct in Oct - Zedillo.

text.p: Mexico's open, or base, unemployment rate fell to 5.2 percent in October from 5.5 percent in September, President Ernesto Zedillo said on Monday.
Open unemployment is defined as members of the workforce older than 12 who have searched for work, but have not worked more than one hour a week for a month.
Zedillo told a meeting of the National Manufacturing Chamber (Canacintra) that the jobless rate was the lowest since the 1994 peso devaluation.
A survey by Reuters of economists MXAAP forecast a jobless rate of 5.28 percent during October.
Zedillo also said the number of permanently insured workers at the Social Security Institute (IMSS) at the end of October was 9.078 million -- a record high.
